meta.name: Born Into Brothels
meta.description: Amidst the supposed growing prosperity of India, there remains a dark underbelly of poverty.Born Into Brothelschronicles this through the lens of the red light district of Sonagchi, Calcutta. Film-maker Zana Briski inspires a group of children of the prostitutes of the area to photograph the most reluctant subjects of it. As the kids excel in their new found art, will this help them have a chance for a better life away from the miserable poverty that threatens to crush their dreams?
